# MissReno

> MissReno is a one-stop renovation centre and showroom in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia. We supply and install feature walls, ceilings, panels and stone, and supply materials to contractors and designers. Established 2023.

## Key facts
- Address: Lot 2, Ground Floor, Lorong Durian 3, Jalan Tuaran, Kian Yap Industrial Estate, 88450 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah
- Opening hours: Mon to Sat, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed on Sunday. (Malaysia time, UTC+8)
- WhatsApp and phone: +6012 835 0133
- Email: admin@missreno.com
- Areas served: Kota Kinabalu, Tuaran, Penampang, Putatan, Papar, Kudat, Sandakan, Tawau and across Sabah
- Fastest way to a quote: WhatsApp a photo of your wall or ceiling. We reply within 2 hours, Mon to Sat.
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/missrenomy, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/missrenomalaysia, TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@missrenomy

## Services
- **Feature walls**: Fluted, stone-look and marble-look walls that turn a plain wall into the centre of the room.
- **Ceilings**: Soffit ceilings, wood-look panels and hidden lighting that lift the whole room.
- **Panels and stone**: Lightweight stone-look and marble-look sheets that give the look of natural stone without the heavy work.
- **Shopfronts and offices**: A sharper entrance, reception or shopfront, planned around your opening hours.

## Product ranges (2026 product catalogue)
- **FlexLam** (Bamboo fibre laminate): No plywood or timber backing needed; Strong and durable; Water resistant and non-formaldehyde; Bendable for curves. Size: 2900 × 1220 × 8 mm sheets.
- **SoliFlute** (Fluted wall panel): Solid, not hollow; Modern design options; Pairs with FlexLam; Edges are easy to touch up. Size: 2900 mm long, 120 to 160 mm wide, 10 to 12 mm thick.
- **Soffit** (Flexible PVC panel for ceilings): Solid, not hollow; Modern design options; Edges are easy to touch up. Size: 2900 × 300 × 11 mm panels.
- **MarbleLux** (UV marble sheet): UV protection layer; Scratch-resistant PET coating; A cost-effective alternative to real marble; Lightweight and easy to install. Size: 2900 × 1220 × 3 mm sheets.
- **StoneSkin** (Clay composite veneer): Suitable for outdoor use; Natural, durable clay material; Lightweight and easy to install; Bendable for curved designs. Size: 1200 × 600 × 5 mm, 3000 × 600 × 5 mm and brick-style tiles.
- **RockNest** (PU stone): Lightweight and easy to install; Realistic stone designs; An affordable alternative to real stone. Size: 1200 × 600 × 25 mm panels.
- **LushLeaf** (Artificial wall plants): Realistic and elegant; Thick texture; UV resistant; Environment friendly. Size: 1000 × 1000 mm panels.
- **ErgoWorks** (Office chairs): Mesh and executive chairs; For offices and meeting rooms. Size: Ask us for the current models.

## Frequently asked questions
### What does MissReno do?
MissReno is a one-stop renovation centre in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. We supply wall and ceiling finishes such as fluted panels, marble-look and stone-look sheets and soffit ceilings, and our own team installs them.

### Where is MissReno located?
MissReno is at Lot 2, Ground Floor, Lorong Durian 3, Jalan Tuaran, Kian Yap Industrial Estate, 88450 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. See the showroom page

### What are the showroom opening hours?
The showroom is open Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Sunday.

### Do I need a full renovation?
No. Many projects upgrade a single wall or ceiling. Send us a photo and we will suggest what suits the space.

### How much does a feature wall cost?
It depends on the finish and the size. The Christmas promotion, 1 to 30 Nov 2026, starts at RM1,899 with installation and SST included for a wall of about 3 m × 3 m. Send a photo for an exact quote.

### How long does installation take?
It depends on the size and the finish. Send us a photo and we will confirm the schedule with your quote.

### Is it messy?
Our team keeps the work tidy and clears the area when the job is done. Tell us about your space and we will explain what to expect.

### Do you deliver outside Kota Kinabalu?
Yes, across Sabah, including Tuaran, Penampang, Putatan, Papar, Kudat, Sandakan and Tawau. Quotes outside Kota Kinabalu depend on distance.

### Do you offer trade pricing?
Yes, for contractors, designers and businesses. Show your business registration once and we will set up a trade account. See trade accounts
